snippet.title: War Of The Zombie Desktop 2018
snippet.description:
Trailer for the new Mac OS version of War Of The Zombie. Also available on mobile for Android and IOS.

War of the Zombie MAC OS:

War of the Zombie Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vanderveergames.wotz

War of the Zombie IOS:
https://itunes.apple.com/app/war-of-the-zombie/id605277717
